Messages.Author: technobabble66
Messages.Body:
Threw this together (hence some cards may be superfluous)

The idea is get Seterpenre out. Give him the 2 Thaum & 2 Fort masters. Get a soul gem on him & burn him. Use the Eternal Mask to raise him again. He takes the gem back. Let TEM burn in an untap phase, burning Seterpenre again & bringing up another minion from the crypt via the gem. Repeat w many TEMs, thus getting lots of high to mid cap minions over several rounds.

Summon the serpent is to get Seterpenre quickly, as he is oldest in crypt & critical
Magic of the Smith to get the gem quickly & safely
Daring the dawn to burn
Heidelberg to swap the gem without an action, allowing Seterpenre free to act(bleed) or block
Villein blood off the tubby minions that get raised, Khobar some if necessary for additional pool (hopefully not necessary tho!)
Eventually swarm bleed w the few remaining bleed mods when the time is ripe.

Whatcha'll think??

Could b tempted to add a Dom angle for bounce & extra bleediness; & add another mokole blood or 2 (i think they may be awesome in this deck)

How do you intend to oust?
Bring up lots of vamps thru Soul Gem trickiness. Bleed prey to death, either directly or via stealth

How do you intend to keep from being ousted?
Bloating like crazy after 5-6 rounds

What do you want your ready region to look like (ie, how many guys are you planning on getting out)?
Initially, either Seterpenre to start with (if lucky) or any other vamp who is then uses Summon the Serpent to bring out Seterpenre. Seterpenre emerges w 2 Thau & 2 Fort.
Shortly thereafter raises 1 new highcap vamp each round. Maybe by round 10 = 5-6 vamps

What do you want your average turn to look like?
Mid-game:
Villein available tubby vamp that was recently raised via Soul Gem
1 vamp plays TEM, raises Seterpenre from ash, he emerges w THAU & FOR.
Seterpenre takes the Gem off whoever has it from the previous raising last turn, or it gets heidelberg'ed over if the castle is out & seterpenre does something like bleed.
Turn ends, and during an untap phase, allow the TEM to burn, burning Seterpenre again & triggering the Gem, raising a new vamp from the crypt.

What's your metagame like? How do your opponents play?
All sorts. Generally see 1 intercept deck & 1 combat deck in most games, with majority being bleed &/or votes.

What problems have you observed with the deck in play?
Not played, but i assume this is another tricky deck that ain't gonna work for some reason - card jam, blocked, sit next to Craig's weenie potence deck again and get smashed off the table ... again :-/
However, running it thru the Card Simulator indicates it may run OK.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
There's a flaw.
Eternal Mask remains in play even if Saterpenre burns. And you can't burn it anymore. So you'll end up with a bunch of numbed Setites who can't do anything , and the allmighty Seterpenre untapped, and ready to oust the world.

And you can't burn the Mask if you don't controlled the regenerated vampire.

One option is to use Martinelli's Ring (to burn the Mask), but then you need to Heidelberg it around.

Yeah the Daring the Dawns are to ensure the first Setepenre can get the Gem & burn simultaneously. From there on, it just allows actions to get thru if its required - namely as a few of the other vamps also have Fort.

I should've mentioned also: the crypt is 14 partly because i thought i waste the first 3 vamps as they probably never come out, and so 14 gives me lots to pull out w the Gem. Also partly because i couldn't decide whether to keep Halim & Zhenga as they're the lowest cap that can do TEM. Also, i was still initially considering the addition of a bit of DOM for flicks. So w this build, i'd be tempted to remove thos 2 & bring it down to 12.
